notes: Access: direct fetch worked throughout, no blocking encountered. Rule 3 sanity check passed: homepage identifies 'Westwing GmbH' as operator (real, publicly-known company; Westwing Group SE is Frankfurt-listed), no closing-down/liquidation banner language, site fully functional. Platform: same custom Shopify Oxygen/Hydrogen storefront family as Westwing UK (c99.json) -- identical oxygen-v2 asset deployment path (29148/15816/32621/4156311) and shared backend host 'store.westwing.com' visible in embedded JSON, confirming this is one Shopify Markets-style multi-country shop rather than a wholly separate platform. INDEPENDENCE VERIFIED regardless: (1) DE homepage pricing is 100% EUR (5 embedded prices sampled, 0 GBP occurrences anywhere on the page); (2) embedded product JSON carries a per-market 'variantStatus' map (e.g. {'FR':'ACTIVE','GB':'INACTIVE',...}) proving each market has its own distinct active/inactive product assortment, not a shared single catalog; (3) DE's own /sitemap-categories.xml lists 574 URLs vs UK's 537, a different set; (4) every single comparable category has a materially different qty from the UK file (e.g. Ceiling Lights 217 DE vs 192 UK, Wall Mirrors 139 vs 109, Bedside Lamps 628 vs 249, Table Lamps 635 vs 256, Candles 143 vs 140) -- this is a genuinely separate country catalogue on shared infrastructure, extracted in full as its own set of rows, exactly as anticipated for IKEA DE/UK in this same batch. Category tree discovered via DE's own /sitemap-categories.xml (574 URLs) filtered to genuine listing pages (most other sitemap entries are single named-product 'shop the look' pages, e.g. /lennon/, /sofia/, not categories) plus the rendered mega-nav (Moebel/Aufbewahrung/Accessoires/Leuchten/Teppiche/Textilien/Geschirr & Servieren/Kueche & Kochen/Kinder/Geschenke). Qty verified on every row via the page's own rendered 'N Produkte' header, cross-confirmed against the identical N in the page's own 'X von N Produkten werden angezeigt' load-more footer text -- both extracted independently from the same fetch; every leaf below passed that double-match. Excluded per standing rules: Weihnachtsbeleuchtung (Christmas Lighting, holiday), Raumduft-Kerzen/Duftkerzen/Weihnachtskerzen (fragrance/scented/holiday candles -- Kerzen itself sampled 28 titles, 0 scented, kept), Kunstblumen (artificial flowers), all Teppiche/Heimtextilien/Bettwaesche/Kissen (rugs/textiles/bedding/cushions), all Weihnachten/Advent nodes (holiday), Moebel/Aufbewahrung/Garten (furniture/storage/outdoor furniture), Toepfe (sampled: Braeter/Kochtopf-Sets -- kitchen cookware, not plant pots despite similar name), Zahnputzbecher (bathroom hardware), Servietten/Servierbesteck/Servierwagen (napkins/cutlery/furniture), Servierzubehoer (sampled 24 titles: dominated by salt-and-pepper mills, oil/vinegar bottles, bottle coolers -- kitchen tools, matches the identical UK exclusion), Deko-Strand (sampled: beach towels, board games, swim rings, cooler boxes -- not decor), Kinderzimmerdeko (sampled: bed canopies, fabric garlands, photo albums, growth charts, birthday decorations -- textiles/party goods dominate, matches UK's Kids Decoration exclusion), Kinder/Kinderzimmer-* other nodes (furniture/storage/textiles), Geschenke/Gutscheine (gifts), Kueche & Kochen appliance/cookware nodes. Two duplicate/near-duplicate cases dropped per Rule 0.6: 'Outdoor-Lichterketten' is byte-identical in population to 'Lichterketten' (same 3 total, same 3 product titles sampled) -- canonical /lichterketten/ kept, duplicate dropped; 'Pflanzentoepfe' (88 total) was found to be a near-duplicate of 'Outdoor-Blumentoepfe' (88 total, identical count, 16 of 21 sampled titles shared verbatim including 'Grosse Outdoor-Uebertoepfe Out, 2er-Set') -- dropped as a synonym-name re-cut of the same population, canonical /outdoor-blumentoepfe/ kept. One genuine type-vs-room overlap kept and documented per Rule 0.6 rather than dropped: 'Blumentoepfe' (237, type-based 'Flower Pots') partially overlaps the room-based Indoor/Outdoor Blumentoepfe split (186+88=274, close to but not identical to the 237 type total) -- both kept, mirroring the identical Flower Pots vs Plant Pots Indoor/Outdoor pattern already documented on Westwing UK. Rule 0 gain: Kinderzimmerlampen (Kids Lighting, 55) kept despite the room word -- genuine lighting fixtures, matching the UK precedent for the same node. No 'Coffee Table Books' equivalent node exists on the DE site (genuine absence, not an oversight -- sitemap has no Bildbaende/Buecher category); DE's 'Karaffen' (150) is a single combined node covering both water carafes and decanters where UK's taxonomy split these into two separate nodes -- kept faithful to the DE site's own single-node structure per the naming rule rather than forced to match UK's split.
